body.prompt: Keep everything in the reference image exactly the same: same scene, composition, characters, faces, expressions, poses, camera angle, lighting, colors and miniature clay style. Only change these things: the small framed portrait of the magpie on the wall has exactly one word written neatly under it in simple dark handwriting: Kachi (spelled K-a-c-h-i), and nothing else is written on it. Every glass jar has a plain red lid and no label at all. Any packets have plain solid colors with no writing. No other letters anywhere in the image.
